assets.prompt: Wide establishing shot concept art for a 3D adventure platformer video game, stylised realism like a modern adventure game. A colossal tropical waterfall pours down a towering dark basalt cliff into a turquoise plunge pool. Flat wet rock ledges and stepping stones jut out of the cliff face at staggered heights like a natural staircase, some covered in lush green moss, with fallen logs wedged between rocks. Thick white mist and spray at the base, warm god rays cutting through the mist from the upper left, dense jungle foliage framing the sides. A small athletic human adventurer in simple outdoor clothes is captured mid-jump between two ledges halfway up, tiny against the scale of the falls. Painterly but detailed, rich saturated greens and teals, cinematic lighting, high detail, no text, no UI.
assets.usedIn: Art direction reference; planned loading / title screen backdrop (Phase 7) and trailer ingredient (Phase 9)

assets.prompt: Ultra-wide seamless panoramic sky and landscape for a video game skybox, equirectangular style, horizon line exactly in the vertical middle of the image and perfectly level. Upper half: bright tropical morning sky, soft blue with scattered warm-lit cumulus clouds and a hazy sun low on the left. Lower half: rolling distant jungle-covered hills and misty valleys fading into atmospheric haze, receding in layers. No waterfall, no river, no buildings, no people, no foreground objects, no text. Left and right edges match so the panorama wraps seamlessly. Stylised realism, painterly, soft atmospheric perspective, same style as a modern adventure game.
assets.notes: Flow has no 2:1 ratio. Generated at 16:9 (1376x768) and stretched to 2048x1024 for the game.

assets.prompt: Character reference sheet (turnaround) for a 3D video game model. One athletic young adult adventurer shown three times at the same scale in a row: front view, side profile view, and back view. Standing upright in a strict T-pose with arms straight out horizontally and legs slightly apart, neutral expression. Simple practical outdoor clothes: fitted rust-orange short-sleeve shirt, dark olive cargo trousers, sturdy brown hiking boots, short dark hair, no backpack, no weapons, no accessories. Full body visible head to toe in every view, feet on the same baseline. Plain flat mid-grey background, even flat studio lighting, no shadows, no text, no labels. Stylised realism like a modern adventure game character.
assets.usedIn: Modelling / image-to-3D reference for the player character (Phase 6)
